# Hot Shot Aviation

> Premier flight training and aircraft rental in Los Angeles, operated by Part 121 airline captains with an in-house DPE.

Hot Shot Aviation offers flight instruction from Private Pilot through ATP, aircraft rental on a modern Piper/Cessna fleet, and on-site checkrides with a Designated Pilot Examiner.
